document.source_location: American noun pronunciation, final syllable schwa

gui.source_location: British and American word pronunciation entries

paas.source_location: PaaS entry explicitly gives the word reading pass. ARPABET derives from the independent CMU pass entry; the reference does not authorize an expanded phrase or changed source spelling.

iaas.source_location: Cloud service models, IaaS: commonly spelled I-A-A-S and sometimes pronounced eye-azz. AY-AE-Z transcribes this published respelling; it is not a published IPA quote. A model must still select the contextual word or letter reading.

saas.source_location: Cloud service models, SaaS explicitly gives word reading sass, alongside the S-A-A-S initialism. ARPABET derives from CMU sass. Contextual pronunciation decisions remain mandatory.

postgresql.source_location: Official pronunciation entry gives post-GRES-que-ell. ARPABET composition uses independent dictionary post and gress plus the conventional Q and L letter sounds. This is a compositional transcription of the published respelling, not a published IPA quote; it does not expand the name or authorize an extra named S.

nas.source_location: NAS, Network Attached Storage entry explicitly gives pronounced nass. ARPABET derives from the independent CMU nass entry. This reference covers the contextual storage-word reading only; it does not authorize spelling the acronym, expanding its name or changing the canonical source.
